filters.description: Field filters as {name: "value" | "value1,value2"} (any-of, case-insensitive). Names per catalogue: metal → category, era, rarity, fictional, tag; mineral → type, system, rarity, gem_quality, color, magic, planar_origin, origin; ingredient → category, rarity, realm, biome, landform, structure, qualifier, essence, creature_type, part; potion → essence; gem → color, rarity, temporary; milieu → realm, group; animal → kind, size, danger, activity, domestic and the place filters; plant → kind and the place filters; monster → type, size, cr, danger and the place filters; hearth_page, passage_page, bearer_page → none (search by name with q). list_facets gives the values.

kind.description: Which catalogue: metal, mineral, ingredient, potion, gem, milieu, animal, plant, monster, hearth_page, passage_page, bearer_page.

lang.description: Language of the texts: en (default), fr, or all for both.
